$comment: ZEVA-Link default design tokens. This is the STARTING point for any L4 (Next.js) back-office / dashboard UI — consume these instead of ad-hoc values, then override per product direction. Map into Tailwind theme.extend or CSS custom properties. Factory-floor operator terminals follow factory-floor-ui-designer instead.

semantic.$comment: Status colors double as SPC / alert severity. Readable in both modes; never rely on color alone — pair with an icon or label.

pairings.name: default-ja
pairings.$comment: Default for JA/EN/ID mixed UI. Noto Sans JP carries CJK; Inter Tight gives headings character.

pairings.name: technical
pairings.display: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'IBM Plex Sans JP', sans-serif
pairings.body: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'IBM Plex Sans JP', sans-serif

typography.numeric: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums (MANDATORY on KPI values, tables, and timestamps)

radius.$comment: Vary radius by component role — do not apply one radius uniformly everywhere.

elevation.darkModeNote: In dark mode prefer surface lightness steps (surface -> surfaceRaised) over shadows.

rules: one directed entrance beats many micro-effects

charts.$comment: Colorblind-considerate categorical palette (Tableau-10 derived). Assign in order; never exceed 8 series without regrouping. Prefer the dataviz skill when available.
rules: axis/gridlines use muted neutrals, data gets the color
label series directly when possible instead of a distant legend
tabular-nums on all axis and tooltip values
